name: Weekly Archon Hunt Run
recommended_loadout: Mesa (for Phase 1/2) or Felarx/Phenmor Devastating Attrition (for Archon fight)
node_directions: Mission 1: Complete the Exterminate or Mobile Defense node
Mission 2: Complete the Interception or Defense node
Mission 3 (Assassination): Navigate to the Archon arena
Phase 1: Deplete first half of Archon health while ignoring damage attenuation
Phase 2: Defeat the summoned Deacon enemies and complete the hunt
